title: Roadmap
intro: One ranking of every project, best first, on a timeline: a row's bar is the span its milestones cover, the shaded band behind it the target window, and flags mark what drifts or is out of rank order. Everyone can read it; administrators and roadmap editors change the ranking.
introEdit: One ranking of every project, best first, on a timeline: a row's bar is the span its milestones cover, the shaded band behind it the target window, and flags mark what drifts or is out of rank order. Drag a row by its handle or use its menu to change the ranking; every change is saved at once. Dropping a row below the Unranked line, or Unrank, takes it out of the ranking; Rank adds an unranked project at the end.
emptyHint: Projects are created on the Plan page and appear here to be ranked.
noMatchHint: Change or clear the filters to see more projects.

flags.title: Flags
flags.intro: What the icons in the Flags column mean, one line per flag: a project running past its target window or starting or ending off it, and a project ranked below another that starts earlier. Warnings first. Nothing is ever moved.
flags.none: No flags on the projects shown.

stale: The roadmap changed in the meantime — the list was reloaded. Your last change was not saved; make it again if you still want it.
saveForbidden: You are not allowed to change the roadmap
saveInvalid: A project in the list no longer exists — the list was reloaded
